items.html:
Natsai M'shangwe is a promising Zimbabwean allrounder who gained significant first-class experience during 2009. He was first selected to play for Zimbabwe A against Namibia at the age of 18. His favourite player is Shahid Afridi for being a true allrounder.
Cricinfo staff January 2010
